_note: Added 2026-08-15. This pack is NOT calibrated: min_score and weak_band are inherited from config/library_config.json defaults, not measured against real motivational imagery, because the library holds almost none yet. Generate the MO tier of library/PROMPT_PACK.md first, then re-run calibration. Until then retrieval will be conservative and leave gaps, which is the correct failure.

voice.steering: Speak with steady conviction, unhurried, building. Long pauses between statements.

_shot_rhythm_note: Motivational faceless video holds one image, or a slow moving background, for a long time. 30s is the intent. It CANNOT be honoured yet: apply_shot_rhythm floors at one shot per segment, so a 47-segment script still yields 47 images however this is set. See ROADMAP.md C1 and tests/test_shot_count_floor.py.
world_anchor: contemporary, no fixed period or place
style_block: Cinematic film still, anamorphic lens, dramatic directional light, deep contrast, muted desaturated colour grade, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, wide negative space for caption text.
negative_block: No text, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no caption, no title card, no motivational slogans rendered in the image, no stock-photo smiling, no plastic-looking skin, no duplicated limbs, no distorted hands, no recognisable celebrity likeness, no brand marks.

golden_hour_figure.prompt: Lone figure at golden hour, long shadow, warm rim light, wide horizon.

cinematic_wide.prompt: Anamorphic cinematic wide, shallow focus, atmospheric haze, teal and amber grade.

bold_graphic.prompt: Bold high-contrast poster illustration, limited palette, strong diagonal composition.
